guards_declared: case 2 withdraw publishes deal+attention before next reply
case 3 deal_reconcile (tier Read, writes) publishes Deal+Receipt
case 6 HouseStatus(Ready) publishes Settings before next reply
case 7 FinishUnlock publishes Settings locked=false before next reply
case 8 tick publishes a deadline default with no message
case 9 (coordinator) keychain-only credentials write publishes Settings before next reply
ledger write_count moves on write, not on read
message classification pinned (Credentials, HouseStatus, Engine, Pause, Resume, Preferences, Select, Token, Reconcile loud; FinishUnlock, BeginUnlock, EngineFinished, AttachMcp loud)
deviations_from_card: Gate shape inverted from the card's dirty flag: instead of a publish_dirty bit set by an enumerated list of in-memory changes, every message publishes unless it is QUIET, and a quiet message publishes only when Ledger::write_count moved. Quiet = Action::reads_only() (exhaustive match, no wildcard, false is the safe default for any new action), Message::Agent, Message::AgentRefused, Message::Engine. So a missed trigger can only come from mis-listing a mutating action as a read, not from forgetting to set a flag; the critic's/coordinator's extra triggers (keychain-only credentials write, AttachMcp, HouseStatus, BeginUnlock/FinishUnlock, EngineFinished, relay/witness/market answers) are all loud by construction. Engine Err path (finish_run Failed) forces a pass. Run snapshots are diffed after every message (in-memory, no keychain), outside the gated pass. No publish_dirty field; service.rs only gains two cfg(test) hooks (publish_tick to hold the tick, publish_passes counter) instead of a paused tokio clock, because tokio has no test-util feature here and adding it is a Cargo.toml change outside the write set. Commits: 2 not 3 (accessor; gate+tests together) because the red cases cannot be committed green before the gate and splitting actor.rs needs interactive staging.
notes: Premise re-verified on HEAD 9205cec: actor.rs ran the full pass after every message. Measured before: 100 get_deal = 1100 keychain reads (11 per pass with 2 open deals), 51 passes for 50 Text events + barrier, 2 passes for a table_view + barrier. After: 0 / 0 / 0. Enumerated non-ledger state the pass shows: house_state (HouseStatus), approval lock (FinishUnlock; idle lock is time-driven -> tick), paused/engine/preferences (always with a ledger write too), relay (construction), keychain paypal.sandbox/channel3 (Credentials only; store_credential's date row is best-effort so it can be keychain-only), runs (diffed every message). Time-driven changes (deadlines, idle lock) now appear within <=1 s via the tick instead of on the next arbitrary message.
